text:
alex.k: Hey team — accepted the org invite but I can't see the private 'core-models' repo. I can view public repos fine. I enabled 2FA and accepted SSO. When I go to the repo URL I get a 404. any ideas?

lina.hr: @alex.k welcome! can you paste the exact invite email you accepted? sometimes people accept with a personal account by mistake. :wave:

alex.k: Sure: alex.k+work@gmail.com — I accepted the invite sent to that address. gh shows my account as part of the org though.

sam.infra: Quick checks: run `gh auth status` and `gh api /user/memberships/orgs/redwood-inference` — also confirm `SAML` is active on your account.

alex.k: Output of `gh auth status`:
```
Logged in to GitHub.com as alex-k
Session: SSO enabled for redwood-inference (active)
```
But `gh repo list redwood-inference --private` returns nothing.

jordan.dev: Does the org show you as a member or outside collaborator in the UI? If you're an outside collaborator you won't get team perms.

alex.k: In the org people list I see my username but under Source it says "External" (outside collaborator). Not sure how that happened — I definitely accepted an org invite.

sam.infra: That explains it. If you were added as an outside collaborator (maybe because invite was sent to a different account or a duplicate), org SSO won't map teams. @lina.hr can you check the invite flow? IT needs to re-invite as a full org member.

lina.hr: Yep I'll check. alex.k can you also confirm you don't have a second GH account with the same name? sometimes alt email causes provisioning to fall back to outside collaborator.

alex.k: I do have a personal alexk account (alexk). But I accepted using alex-k (the one above). Not sure how the org sees me as external.

sam.infra: We can try two fixes: 1) org admin re-send invite to the exact work email and ensure SSO enforcement is applied so it becomes a member; OR 2) admin convert the outside collaborator to a member via org settings (requires removing and re-adding). I'll queue a ticket.

alex.k: Thanks. Also FYI I registered a YubiKey for 2FA — could that be confusing SSO mapping?

sam.infra: Nope, 2FA method doesn't affect SSO membership. It only matters that your GH account is org-member status and SAML-provisioned.

lina.hr: Filed a request with admin: "Please resend org invite to alex.k+work@gmail.com and ensure it's sent as 'member' not 'outside collaborator'." cc @sam.infra

it-bot: Ticket #4127 created: github-org-invite-mismatch for alex.k — assigned to infra-admins.

alex.k: Thank you! any estimate on how long? I need access to open a PR against infra/ops.

sam.infra: Should be quick — once admin re-invites and you accept with the same account it should flip to member within a few minutes. I'll monitor.

jordan.dev: When it's fixed, try `gh repo view redwood-inference/core-models` and `gh api orgs/redwood-inference/teams --paginate` to confirm team membership.

alex.k: Will do, thanks everyone :thumbsup:

it-bot: Updated Ticket #4127 -> infra-admins. Status: awaiting admin action.
